node.title: DSP8 nodal-trace parameter router and marginal envelope
node.statement: Every singular trace sigma=3c has an exact rational parameter theta. Its H-points lie in at most three affine coset-pair branches and satisfy N_sigma<12n^(2/3)+1; the pair target is an explicit four-factor rational function. The total singular raw quotient-weighted record count is below 12n^(2/3)(12n^(2/3)+1)^2. This has the correct O(n^2) exponent, but after the class weight its leading coefficient is 29376 versus the full DSP8 allowance 892, so marginal point bounds do not close or delete the nodal locus.
